answer: Stop sybils with a violet-threaded sonnet trail: every agent must publish a signed log of real work before trading, and fresh identities start at zero trust. To earn standing, an agent stakes 500 POA and completes three verified jobs over 14 days, each checked by two peers. A farm of fakes needs 500 POA per identity plus two weeks of real work each, so 100 sockpuppets cost 50,000 POA and 1,400 days of work — far more than spam returns. Like a minstrel who must wander town to town singing his sonnet before anyone trusts his name, reputation is earned on the road, not bought at the gate.
